program_overview.title: React.js Complete Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: The frontend library hiring still runs on, learned to production depth: hooks, state, TypeScript, testing and Next.js, ending deployed.
program_overview.description:
React remains the most-hired frontend skill by a wide margin, and the gap between tutorial React and production React is where careers are decided. This live online masterclass closes it: JavaScript foundations first, then React as it is actually written, function components, hooks, honest data patterns, real state management with Redux Toolkit, then the production layer: TypeScript throughout, testing that catches regressions, performance measured before optimized, and Next.js as the industry wrapper. A finale month ships a production-shaped capstone and sits the final exam.

The pace is honest: ten teaching months at two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice, with two more in hand. Problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate with a free retest.
what_makes_this_different: JavaScript depth first: React punishes weak JavaScript forever
Production patterns, not tutorial patterns: loading states, error boundaries and data honesty throughout
TypeScript and testing as core phases, not appendices
Next.js taught as the industry actually uses it
An honest 10-month arc with 2 months in hand
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams and a final exam with a free retest

faqs.question: What does this React masterclass cover?
faqs.answer: JavaScript foundations first, then React as production teams write it: components and hooks in depth, honest data patterns, state management with Redux Toolkit, then the production layer, TypeScript throughout, testing with React Testing Library, performance measured before optimized, and Next.js. A finale month ships a deployed, tested capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn React properly?
faqs.answer: Ten months of teaching at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who need them. The three teaching phases build the skill and its real-world application; the finale month ships a capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Does this course include React Native?
faqs.answer: No, honestly: mobile is its own discipline with its own course here (our app development track), and stapling it on would cheat both. What this course guarantees is the React depth React Native then assumes, students who continue into the app course arrive ready.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Can I try a class before enrolling?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor reading your actual code, never pre-recorded videos.
